title: The Multiplicity One Defect and Congruence-Modular Exponent Ratios
summary: We introduce a multiplicity one defect that quantitatively measures the failure of multiplicity one for the Jacobian of the Shimura curve \(X^D(M)\) attached to an indefinite rational quaternion algebra of discriminant \(D\) and level \(M\), localized at a maximal ideal of the Hecke algebra. By constructing a certain lattice inside the local Tate module, we obtain an explicit upper bound for the defect in terms of congruences between eigenforms and the lattice-Tate module discrepancies associated with the individual newforms.
